cards.industry_contour: Industrial stormwater; storage pond overflow; wetlands and rivers
current_npa: KoAP RF arts.7.6,8.1,8.13(4) cited by prosecutor
cards.factual_pattern: Industrial stormwater -> storage ponds -> overflow -> Dudkinskoe wetland -> Dudkinsky creek -> Gorky reservoir
cards.risk: Undocumented physical discharge via overflow, despite no designed direct outfall
cards.evidence_court_practice: Prosecutor reported administrative fines totalling over RUB 60,000 and corrective representation; not a court judgment.
diagnostic_questions: Could design rainfall or snowmelt exceed pond capacity?
Does overflow reach any ditch, wetland, creek or river?
Do operational logs and permits match actual routing?
Are capacity, sampling and emergency arrangements verified?
cards.red_flag: No discharge claimed because water is stored; overflow route not assessed.
mirlex_checks: Compare permits, operating records and samples

impact.assistant: Ask about overflow and final receiving waterbody

cards.engine_update: ENG-UNI-STORM-001 exists; no new ACTIVE legal rule; link evidence to existing ID.
